rules.title: A thesis for the doctoral degree must constitute original scholarship and must be a distinct contribution to knowledge
(as PhD2) are required to take 6-9 credits of courses at level 500 or higher selected in consultation with the thesis supervisor
Students entering with a B.Sc (as PhD1) are required to take 18-21 credits of courses at the 500 level or higher selected in consultation with the thesis supervisor

Students with adequate preparation (typically the equivalent of more than four courses at the 500 level or higher) may request special departmental approval to take the following course as a complementary course
